releaseNotes:
## ✨ Improvements

### 🗂️ Sessions

- Added session deletion with a confirmation dialog. The session is removed from the list once deletion succeeds, and a failure to refresh the list is reported separately.
- The confirmation dialog supports keyboard navigation and keeps focus inside the dialog while deletion runs.

### 🖥️ Interface

- Side panels (processing, notes and transcript) can now be collapsed and expanded.
- Panel collapse state is remembered between launches.

## 🛠️ Fixes

- Reduced memory use when cleaning up audio by processing recordings as a stream instead of loading them fully into memory.
- Improved echo cleanup between microphone and system audio.
- Kept microphone and system audio aligned across pause and resume.

## 💻 Compatibility

- Supports Windows 10 and 11, x64.
- Preserves existing recordings, transcripts, settings, credentials, and installed model locations during upgrades.

🛸 Co-authored with [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/nova)
